svg.title: Luomo
svg.desc: A midnight plate: a half-digital moon, a pole glowing in seven colours, a four-star constellation and a yellow splash line that pulses beside the name Luomo.
svg.text: 洛墨 · 天染 · 依然
a quiet builder of small, lasting things.
